verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes standard US commercial fee rates (Checkout 3.49%+, cards 2.99%+, etc.) and documents that agent-originated payments (via Braintree delegated tokens or Google Pay tokens) are processed through the merchant's existing Braintree/PayPal integration, implying standard rates apply — but the evidence explicitly notes 'No separate agentic/AI-channel fee schedule is published on the page,' and access to Agentic Commerce Services/Store Sync requires a form-gated sales-style onboarding process. Missing for 10: an explicit agent-channel fee line item, confirmation that no markup/negotiated rate applies to agentic transactions, and self-serve pricing disclosure independent of the sales-contact onboarding gate.
